title: API Error Contract
content:
Purpose: API Error Contract.

Technical details: The API returns structured errors containing code, message, request_id, and timestamp. HTTP 400 indicates invalid input, 401 authentication failure, 403 authorization failure, 429 throttling, and 5xx server errors.

Operational guidance: Troubleshooting should preserve request_id, status code, endpoint, time, and a sanitized request sample.

Investigation evidence: Record affected services, timestamps, correlation identifiers, observed behavior, expected behavior, recent changes, and reproducible diagnostic steps.

Verification: Compare outcomes against documented requirements. Do not claim a root cause without supporting evidence. Document unresolved uncertainty and recommended follow-up.
